steps.name: Morning in LaChouette
steps.objective: Turn in the quest to [Narsha] in 「LaChouette Slums Entrance」.

steps.name: Kaina's Message
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Narsha] in 「LaChouette Slums Entrance」, then go to the portal near [Silvia] in 「Glaston Central Plaza」.
2. After the conversation, enter 「Street North of the Plaza」 and turn in the quest to [Leticia].

lines.text: (Little birds settle on the washing lines strung between houses and chirp as though announcing the morning.)
(Outside the inn, Narsha watches them and gives a small yawn.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yaaawn...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Doing nothing but resting makes my whole body feel stiff. Yaaawn.
(Stretching, Narsha senses someone approaching and turns.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Hello, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you sleep well, Narsha?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I barely managed to fall asleep.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I'm very, very grateful for Her Majesty's kindness. But I keep wondering if I deserve all this.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: She replaced every bed in the LaChouette inn with a luxurious one, provided treats you'd expect only at the palace...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: And there are knights stationed all around the inn and the streets...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Narsha looks a little tired...)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: %s, I want to go home.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I know you do, Narsha. Just hold on a little longer. Her Majesty asked us to wait.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I've never stayed in Glaston this long before. Perhaps that's why.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Um... Has Raven done something bad?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: If the knights are looking for him, it must be serious.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Hmm... Huh?
(A great shadow falls over Narsha, as though swallowing the sun.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Have you both been resting well?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Welcome, Argent. We have, thanks to Her Majesty's care.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I'm glad.
(Argent meets Narsha's eyes.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Narsha, a paladin called Platina will come tomorrow on Her Majesty's orders.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: He will escort you home. He'll bring your card, too, so be sure to ask him for it.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Oh, my card... Thank you, Argent.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's good news, Narsha.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: We will explain everything concerning the Bureau mage Raven when the time comes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is finding him taking longer than expected?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: There's somewhere I'd like you to come with me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh... Of course. I'll get ready.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I'll wait here.
(While the adventurer goes inside to gather their belongings, Narsha and Argent meet each other's eyes.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Um... Argent.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Yes, Narsha?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Is the place you're taking the adventurer dangerous?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: No. We are only going together so I can relay Her Majesty's message. She said everything would be all right. You needn't worry.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: That's a relief. I thought it might be somewhere dangerous again...
(Narsha falls quiet as the adventurer returns.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm ready, Argent. And Narsha...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes, Adventurer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know when I'll be back, so I'll say goodbye now.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: It's all right, %s. I enjoyed coming to Glaston with you. See you again. Take care, too, Argent.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Goodbye, Narsha.
(Narsha bids Argent and %s farewell, then returns to the inn.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where are we going, Argent?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Follow me.
(Argent leads the way to a street beside a café in the square. Along the way, residents greet him or look at him with admiration.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The people really trust Argent. Hm?)
(Argent stops ahead and turns.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: This way. This street leads to the administrative district.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The administrative district...

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Where the government offices handle affairs of state. Explaining them all would take forever, but one you would recognize, %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Magic Bureau.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Correct. We can discuss the Bureau shortly. First, there's a friend I'd like to introduce.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Silvia? I've already met her.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Not Silvia. Forgive me, but why did you think I meant her... ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She's coming this way.
(Silvia, walking from the northern street toward the square, spots Argent and stops.)

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: ...Haah. Running into Argent during my precious break...
(Argent's expression stiffens at the sight of Silvia.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I believe you're supposed to be working now.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Do you think I'm slacking off? What are you doing here, anyway? Surely you didn't come just to lecture me.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I have business with %s in the administrative district... I won't explain at length. Satisfied?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Really? Then carry on and leave me be.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: The Archives has a break room. Why come all the way to the square... ?

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: Everyone in the office is older than me. As the youngest, I feel awkward taking over the only break room.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: They said I could step outside for a while, so here I am.
(Apparently satisfied, Argent nods.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I understand. Take a short break, then return. And here...
(Argent takes Silvia's hand and presses several gold coins into it.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: You can never go long without a snack. Buy something before you return. Something for your colleagues, too.

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: At your command, Commander.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Try obeying me at other times, too.
(Silvia pockets the coins and grins.)

lines.speaker: 실비아
lines.text: See you later, %s. You too, big brother. Work hard.
(Brightening, Silvia hurries into the café.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You two seem close.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I'm not so sure...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha... All right.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: This way, please.

steps.name: An Unusual Girl
steps.objective: Talk to [Leticia] in 「Street North of the Plaza」, then turn in the quest to [Iris] in 「Oracle Chamber」.

lines.text: (Following Argent up the street north of the square, %s sees another district in the distance.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's the administrative district.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Indeed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You called this the northern street? It seems rather quiet.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: The morning commute has already passed.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Let me get to the point. Her Majesty sent a message.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: She intends to put pressure on the council's nobles soon. And she has a request.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: When the recent incident was resolved, the magic shaking Glaston briefly stopped. Raven disappeared during that interval.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: It seems likely to be connected...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who exactly is this mage Raven?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: We don't know every detail, but he was at the center of the Bureau's wrongdoing.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: He tried to awaken a demon god through No Name and Atalante, and planned to use Narsha by another method.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then Her Majesty's request is...

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Exactly. Find evidence of Raven's actions.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's been a while. Couldn't he have destroyed the evidence by now?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Her Majesty says something remains beyond Raven's reach. We need information about that object.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something Raven can't touch...

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Perhaps something ordinary humans cannot find or handle.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm... I understand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Give me a little time.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Of course. I'll inform Her Majesty.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, where's the person you wanted to introduce?
(Argent points to a girl in the distance, looking around.)
(The girl turns from the administrative district as she notices them.)
Oh, Commander?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: No formalities.
Okay! Nothing major has happened in the administrative district. You said to report even little things, so here goes.
The Magic Bureau building isn't shaking anymore.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Shaking...?)
The mages say all the magical tools inside cause their magic to collide. The aftershocks make the building shake now and then.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: When did it stop?
Around when Her Majesty visited LaChouette recently, I think.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could it be...
...What's wrong?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Nothing...
(After reporting to Argent, the girl smiles brightly and waves.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Hello! I'm Leticia, a knight. You can call me Letty.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A knight? I wouldn't have guessed.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I am, hehe. Not a regular knight, though. A free knight.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I used to be a squire. Then I fell for a promise that I could become like a Terror Knight and helped with the Bureau's research. Something went wrong, and I had to leave.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: My clothes threw you off, didn't they? The Commander said I could wear whatever I liked, as long as I did my duty.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I'm sorry... I should have stopped it...

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: What are you sorry for, Commander? I'm fine. I'm not sick or anything.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: And I got telekinesis, just like that! I like it. It's cool, like a Terror Knight.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: That's not what a Terror Knight...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Bureau research? Telekinesis?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yep! If I concentrate, I can lift small objects. Watch my hand.
(Leticia points at a small stone on the ground. After a moment, it rises and follows her gestures.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Speechless? You must be surprised! So was I when I suddenly found I could do it. Hehe.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Letty, I told you not to show that so freely...

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: ...Everyone in Glaston knows. Silvia said it was cool, too.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Her Majesty did say to leave it alone, but already...

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Whatever kind of ability it is, I want to use it well and do something wonderful. Like you, Commander.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: ...Letty. Enough.
(Seeing Argent's deep frown, Leticia finally steps back.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Okay. Sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd like to hear more about the Bureau's research...

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Letty won't be able to give you a clear answer. Every memory of the research process is gone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I suppose there's nothing we can do.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: What brings you here, Commander?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I came to introduce you to %s. I expect there will be a task where you can help %s later.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Oh, an escort mission? I've always wanted to try one.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: A kind of escort duty... That may be the simplest way to think of it.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Understood, Commander. I'll guard %s with everything I've got!

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Please introduce yourself, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sorry, I should have done that sooner. I'm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I briefly introduce myself to Leticia.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow, you're amazing! I had no idea who I was meeting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. I'm glad to have your help, Letty.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I'm glad to work with you, too.
(Leticia takes %s's hand and shakes it.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Can I ask a favor? Someone as impressive as you must have an imperial authorization card, right? Could I see it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This one?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow, it's real! I've never seen one before. With that, even passing soldiers won't dare bother you.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: As you know, %s, the card marks the imperial family's recognition and grants its holder corresponding privileges.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: The soldiers have recently received a firm warning. They should not treat you disrespectfully.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: That's wonderful!

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Letty. Isn't it time for your patrol?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Oh, right! Look at the time. I'd better check the administrative district.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: See you later, %s. Commander.
(Leticia says goodbye to Argent and %s, then runs straight toward the administrative district.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Despite appearances, she's a skilled knight.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you say so, Argent, I believe it.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: When you return to Glaston, find Leticia directly. She knows everything happening in the administrative district.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. I'll make a brief visit to the Sanctuary.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Ah, that's why you asked for time... Understood. Until then.

steps.name: A Troubled Heart
steps.objective: Talk to [Iris] in 「Oracle Chamber」, then turn in the quest to [Leticia] in 「Street North of the Plaza」.

lines.text: (The space that always welcomed the adventurer with white light and flowers feels a little lonely.)
(Iris stands at its center, eyes closed.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Oh? %s... When did you get here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's wrong, Iris?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I didn't sense you coming. You startled me. Oh, there's something I want to tell you, %s.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Until recently, I felt frightened and uneasy. But I saw hope beyond the Great Wall. A little longer, and things will get better.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It's all thanks to you, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's because you're doing well, Iris.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I have to keep going a little longer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why don't you rest for a moment? You've done so much. You look tired.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: You know I can't rest. If something beyond our control happened while I stopped...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it's Hecate's visit that's worrying you...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: No. Hecate must sense my resolve, too.
(Iris hesitates.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: After Hecate visited, I remembered my grandmother.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your grandmother?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: At some point, I seem to have forgotten her. My grandmother, who passed away.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: My only family. Someone so precious to me. How could I have forgotten her...?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I couldn't recall her, as though part of my memory had been erased...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you remember everything now?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Almost. But how she died... That's the only thing I can't remember.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: As though someone is preventing me from recalling it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Phew... Oh?
(As though realizing something, Iris gives a gentle stretch.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: That tight feeling is gone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I should have told you sooner. Keeping it to myself was weighing on me. I promised not to hide things from you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...This is different. It's all right.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're really all right?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes... Oh, that's right. You came about Her Majesty's request?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Wait, you can hear what's happening in Glaston now?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: With the spirits' help, I can learn quite a bit, apart from certain areas.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You mean... the Magic Bureau?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Exactly. If there's anything I can help with, tell me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?
(Iris quietly nods.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Iris. Nothing right now, but if something comes up, I'll ask.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: All right... How are you feeling?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've rested, but I'm not sure.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Would you like to stay a little longer? You'll recover soon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Would that be all right?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Of course.
(The adventurer rests for a while in the Oracle Chamber, then returns to Glaston with Iris's help.)

steps.name: A Noisy Street
steps.objective: Talk to [Leticia] in 「Street North of the Plaza」, then defeat [Novice Owl Mage] in 「Glaston Administrative District」. Then turn in the quest to [Leticia] in 「Glaston Administrative District」.

lines.speaker: 사람들의 목소리
lines.text: Everyone, get to the square! Evacuate, quickly! Cough, cough.

lines.speaker: 사람들의 목소리
lines.text: Elderly people and children first! That way, to the square!
(Voices rise through streets so thick with dust that nothing can be seen.)
(Through the dust, the street north of the square gradually emerges.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? Am I here? What's with all this dust?

lines.speaker: 사람들의 목소리
lines.text: Don't stand there! Get out! Head to the square! Cough, cough.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...What happened here?
(As the adventurer moves forward to investigate, another great cloud of dust swirls up. An inhuman shadow emerges.)
(The creature rushes toward the fleeing people, then crashes down at the adventurer's feet.)
Thud.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...What is this?
(The fallen creature resembles a golem formed from a mass of spellbooks.)
Phew... Glad I stopped it.
(Someone sighs in relief at the fallen monster.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s? Oh, it's terrible!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Calm down.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Monsters suddenly came out of the Magic Bureau while I was patrolling! I reported to the Commander and called the knights. We're evacuating everyone!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Monsters? From the Magic Bureau?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yes! From the Bureau!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right, Letty?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I'm fine! We have to stop the monsters!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She really does seem fine. Everyone evacuating keeps coughing...)
(As the adventurer looks around, knights armed with huge gauntlets fill the street.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Letty, has everyone over there been evacuated? Cough, cough.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yes, Commander!

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: The knights have checked this side, but go farther in, just in case... Oh, %s? You're here?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I'm glad you're safe. Let me explain the situation.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: A kind of noxious vapor is spreading from the Magic Bureau in the form of dust. Monsters drawn to it have appeared in the streets.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: The vapor isn't highly dangerous, but the monsters could reach the square or palace. The knights are moving into the administrative district to contain them.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Perhaps now is...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. This seems to be the moment.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Understood.
(Argent nods, then turns his gaze to Letty.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Commander, what do you mean?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Letty. A special assignment.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: A special assignment?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Escort %s to the Magic Bureau immediately. If you find anyone who hasn't evacuated, direct them to safety.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Got it! I mean, understood, Commander.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We'll go now.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Until later, %s.
(Argent puts on the helmet in his hand and runs off. The waiting knights follow him.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If they've deployed that many knights, there must be a lot of monsters.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: There are! I've already taken down dozens myself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He said she was a skilled knight. Is she really that good?)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Aren't you coming, %s? At this rate, we won't even get near the Bureau! I'll guide you. Hurry!
(From the moment they enter the administrative district, monsters block their path.)
(The creatures have numbers on their side, but little strength. They fall helplessly before the pair.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow, %s! Amazing! You took out all those monsters at once. Just like that!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You fought well, too, Letty.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Hehe. Thank you! Follow this road, and we'll reach the Magic Bureau.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Oh, %s, someone's over there. He looks like a Bureau mage. So exhausted... Maybe he's been working for days without going home.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A mage?
(Where Leticia points, a familiar mage walks away: disheveled hair, large glasses, and a spellbook held against his chest.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wait. Is that... Raven?)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: You there! Mister Mage!
(At Leticia's call, Raven turns. Spotting the adventurer, he breaks into a run.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Mister Mage! Where are you going? Come back!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, Letty...

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where do I start? It's complicated...

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I don't know the details, but the Bureau's mages are involved in this, right?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: All this is happening around their headquarters, but not one of them has appeared. They aren't evacuating, either. What are they doing?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty, where is the Magic Bureau?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: At the highest point you can see when you enter the administrative district. You can't see it from here... Oh, the dust cleared.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I know a shortcut. Follow me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lead the way, Letty.

steps.name: A Building Bursting with Magic
steps.objective: Talk to [Leticia] in 「Glaston Administrative District」, then defeat [Prim Optica] and [Elemental Book Golem] in 「Glaston Administrative District」. Then turn in the quest to [Leticia] in 「Glaston Administrative District」.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: We're here, %s. This is the Magic Bureau.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So this is it...
(The white building is smaller than the other government offices and radiates an ominous atmosphere. Something inside makes it tremble.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Something's definitely wrong...
(As Leticia approaches the building, a loud birdcall rings out.)
HOOOOOT!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (An owl?)
(An owl wearing a wizard's hat flies over and drops in front of Leticia.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Peekaboo? Peekaboo! Wake up!
(Leticia lifts the fallen owl with both hands. Recognizing her, it bursts into cries.)

lines.speaker: 피카부
lines.text: Hooooot! Hooooot!

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Peekaboo, isn't this your day off? What happened?

lines.speaker: 피카부
lines.text: HOOOOOT! Hoot!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is the owl saying, Letty?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I don't know. Humans can't understand owls, can they?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Peekaboo, we're going into the Magic Bureau.

lines.speaker: 피카부
lines.text: Hooooot! Hooooot!
(Alarmed, the owl flies in front of her and blocks the way.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, I think Peekaboo is telling us not to go inside. Something has definitely happened...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty, this owl understands human speech to some extent, right?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yes. Peekaboo is clever and can use magic, so the Bureau's mages have kept him for years.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: He's good at magic and errands. Everyone loves him, especially the children.

lines.speaker: 피카부
lines.text: Hoot!
(Peekaboo flaps as though agreeing, then points at the Bureau and crosses his wings into an X.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So we can't go in like this? Is there anyone who understands owls?
Chirp-chirp.
(A familiar chirp sounds, and a huge, dark shadow falls over the Magic Bureau.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Aaaaah! What is that? It's f-falling!
(Something huge and blue drops toward them, but the sound it makes is not what they expected.)
Pop.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow! The fat bird shrank and landed on %s's head!
Chirp-chirp. Chirp.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sylphid? How did you get here?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. I flew. And you, little one. I'm not fat.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Whoa. A talking bird.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Peekaboo says the magic inside that building is running wild. Something in the storeroom... What?

lines.speaker: 피카부
lines.text: Hooooot!

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. The forbidden books have been unsealed. Peekaboo doesn't know how. He's asking us to save his friends inside...

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. Oh dear. No one can enter like this. The magic pouring from those books doesn't belong to our world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. It's a long explanation, %s. I'll work on this. Deal with the nasty creatures nearby.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. Meanwhile, Peekaboo and I will disperse some of this magic.

lines.speaker: 피카부
lines.text: Hoot?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Listen, Peekaboo. We need every wing and beak we can get. You can't stand around, can you?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. No time for lectures. Hurry, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll leave it to you, Sylphid. You heard him, Letty?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: You mean the bluebird talking?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll explain later. For now, do as Sylphid says and keep the monsters away.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Got it. They won't get anywhere near!

steps.name: The Unsealed Forbidden Tome
steps.objective: Talk to [Leticia] in 「Glaston Administrative District」, then defeat [Ego Notorai] in 「Corrupted Magic Bureau」. Then turn in the quest to [Leticia] in 「Glaston Administrative District」.

lines.speaker: 피카부
lines.text: Hoooooot!

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. That's the spirit. Let's do this!
(Sylphid flies above the Magic Bureau with Peekaboo and beats his short wings vigorously.)
(A wind charged with powerful magic reaches the Bureau, and the trembling building becomes still.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. That should do. Peekaboo, fetch the others. Wait... Hold on. Do you know who that is?

lines.speaker: 피카부
lines.text: Hoot? Huh?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. A mage called Raven?
(The mage approaching the Bureau looks up at the sky.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: I wondered who could disperse those magical currents so skillfully. A Spirit King, of course.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Who are you?
(Raven gives a faint smile as Sylphid flies down before him.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: If only we'd met a little sooner. What a shame.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: You would have made excellent material for Demiurgos...
(Understanding his meaning, Sylphid frowns deeply and extends a small wing.)
(Spiraling clouds begin to gather from somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: I have important work. No time to waste on a mere spirit...
(A shadow falls over Raven's face. His spellbook opens, and several black arms reach from its pages.)
(Sylphid flies to avoid them, but one catches his ankle.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: I won't destroy you. Bear with it for now. I haven't time to study you...
(Raven chuckles and hurries inside the Bureau. The black arms spread into a great dark veil, threatening to swallow Sylphid.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp! Wh-what is this...? Nngh!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sylphid!
(The adventurer tears open the dark veil and pulls Sylphid free.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. I'm fi... Huh?
(Sylphid climbs onto %s's head and looks toward the Bureau.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...It's shaking harder than before...

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. Since that mage who mentioned the demon god went inside, the magic has grown much more violent.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: So the magic is reacting to him?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Clever little one.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Thank you, Mister Bluebird.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Sylphid?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. You were planning to enter the Bureau, weren't you? And find that mage?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Then hurry inside. I'll call the spirits and keep the magic from escaping.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. And you, little one. Look after %s.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow, Mister Bluebird. You're a spirit?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. A Spirit King.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: You're small now, but you were huge before. Were you so big because you're a king?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. Exactly. A king-sized king! No, that's not important. Get going!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We'll leave it to you, Sylphid. Are you sure you're up for this, Letty? It could be dangerous.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I'm a knight. I protect the people and carry out my duties! I can't turn my back on what's happening right in front of me!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew. All right. Follow me carefully.
(The adventurer and Leticia head into the Magic Bureau, shaking under the force of magic.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. What an unusual human child... Now, Peekaboo.

lines.speaker: 피카부
lines.text: Hoot?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp-chirp. Let's save your friends. Just like before. Give it everything you've got!
(As they cautiously enter, the Bureau's interior feels utterly alien, unlike any ordinary government office.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s... Wh-what is this... ?
(Unable to believe her eyes, Leticia rubs them repeatedly.)
(What appears to be the lobby is twisted and warped. Spellbooks and magical tools float overhead.)
(On the floor, shadows like the dark veil that tried to swallow Sylphid flicker like flames.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Time and space seem distorted... And the power I feel here...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Is no ordinary power...)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, l-look over there.
(A staircase that once led upstairs stretches endlessly, twisted out of shape. Far along it, Raven wanders, unsure of the way.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where is Raven going... ?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: The wall with the bookcase and grandfather clock is halfway between the third and fourth floors, on the left.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? How do you know, Letty? Magic has twisted this whole space...

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I told you I got completely fooled before. I've been inside the Bureau. I remember.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I know roughly what's in the lobby and corridors. I think of it like untangling a knotted string, and there it is!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yep. But how far are we going?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We need to find out what object Raven needs.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: If I knew what it was, I might be able to get it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We don't know exactly. We'll have to search the place. Huh?
(The distorted Bureau shakes, and a strange, seemingly artificial sound echoes from somewhere.)
Grrrrrrrr—

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where is that coming from?
Grrrrrrrr—

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, I found where the sound is coming from.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You know where it is?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yes, over there. Follow me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty, stop.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Oh, okay...
(Something lying in wait lunges from the darkness. But %s saw it coming and strikes it down.)
Thud.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Th-that was close.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right, Letty? But this is...
(Leticia looks at the fallen creature and falls silent.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: That's the mage who asked me to help with the research. Why did he become a monster and attack us... ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's no time, Letty. Look where we were heading.
(Beings that were human until recently stare at %s and Leticia, now monstrous. Leticia falters at the sight of them poised to attack.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't explain everything, but the mages who stayed inside the Bureau may all have become like that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now that we're here, we can't simply turn back. Leaving like this could put Glaston in even greater danger.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I understand. I'll pull myself together.
(Leticia gives the adventurer a small smile. Together, they charge at the creatures rushing toward them.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Haah... Haah...
(Her legs apparently weakening, Leticia grips the twisted staircase's railing and pulls herself upright.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right, Letty?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I-I'm fine. I've never fought so many enemies before...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Would you like a short rest?
(Letty drinks the potion %s hands her, then stretches.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Why rest? We're here!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We're here?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I think this is it. I can feel something behind there.
Grrrrrrrr—
(As %s and Leticia move forward, something like a monster's cry reaches them.)
Grrrrrrrr—
(The growling slowly swells, as though awaiting them. Yet there is no trace of a monster in the enclosed space.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why can we hear it, but see nothing... ?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: ...Look over there, %s.
(Something unrecognizable rises into the air behind the spot Leticia points to.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: A spellbook...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty, get back!
Grrrrrrrr—
(An enormous, ghostlike being appears behind the floating spellbook, making a strange noise.)
(The oddly shaped creature stares at them. It is impossible to tell whether it is a spirit or a demon.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, wh-what is that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure, but I think that monster is what did this to the Magic Bureau.
(As they watch for an opening to attack the monster, Raven appears in the distance.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: So Notoria is the only forbidden tome whose seal has broken. I'll have to unseal the rest myself.
(The monster called Notoria turns toward Raven and roars.)
GROOOOAR!

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Notoria. I'll give you what you want. Just wait a moment.
(Notoria slows its movements at Raven's words. Looking satisfied, Raven walks past it.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Where are the other forbidden tomes...? They should be around here...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Raven, stop. What are you doing?

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: I'll leave as soon as I find what I need. I have no desire to deal with you, and no time for it either.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You did all this to the Magic Bureau just to find those books?

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: You know about the forbidden tomes. Are you looking for them too? Why? Even if you find them, you couldn't use them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Answer me.
(Raven ignores %s's question and keeps looking around.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Raven! Whatever you're planning, stop. Put the Magic Bureau back the way it was. People have turned into monsters!

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: People? What about them?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: What are you talking about, Mr. Mage? Don't you know what people are?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty... Let me handle this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Raven. You're endangering everyone in Glaston, as well as the mages in this building. Stop what you're doing.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Stop?

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Why should I?

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: You destroyed something I spent so long creating. Why should I stop?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You don't mean...

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: I didn't stop when Jerenis told me to...! I have a calling.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: For this world, a world without a god... For all the lives within it...

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: I researched and researched, and you ruined it. But that's all right. I still have the power to try again. I can start over.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Find a place to nourish it, create a vessel...

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: This is why everyone says mages have no social skills. You shut yourselves away in the dark, reading weird books and saying weird things.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Could you try making sense?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty... That mage has committed terrible crimes. Argent is hunting him down.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Really? So he's a bad guy. We'd better catch him and teach him a lesson.
(Raven stops searching for the forbidden tomes and frowns at them.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Ego Notoria.
GROOOOAR...
(The monster turns toward Raven.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Primordial power awakened from a forbidden tome. Blood and tears taken from countless slaughtered angels and demons. Soon I shall forge the key to set you free.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Kill those two while I find Goetia, Theurgia, Paulina, Almadel, and Nova!
(At Raven's command, the motionless Notoria rises into the air.)
(It lunges at them with a chilling cry that seems to belong to no creature of this world.)
(Raven watches in disbelief as %s's strike disperses Ego Notoria like smoke. He is so shocked that he drops the book he is holding.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: N-Notoria, gone just like that...? I... I don't believe it...

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: A thoughtform embodying part of the world's truth, destroyed by a mere adventurer? That's impossible...

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: ...Because you have a god's blessing? No. Even so, after all I went through to break the seal... How could you...

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: It had to return to the book to become complete!
(As Ego Notoria vanishes, shadows stain the forbidden tome that accompanied it. The book crumbles into ash.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's over, Raven. Admit what you've done and answer for your crimes.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: That was amazing, %s! You're like a hero defeating the villain!
(Raven calmly picks up the book he dropped.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Crimes? What exactly have I done wrong?

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: I merely did what those with transcendent power do. I showed the ignorant the right path...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's absurd. What gives you the right to treat other human beings like...

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: I have no particular desire to make you understand.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: I've waited centuries for this moment... I won't abandon my plans just because I've lost Notoria...
(Raven opens one of the books he is carrying and places a hand upon it.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Try anything funny and you'll be sorry!
(Leticia darts forward to kick Raven, but the Magic Bureau begins to shake violently.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Ugh!
(Leaving the fallen Leticia behind, the adventurer charges at Raven. But his spell stretches the warped space between them, carrying him farther away.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Paulina, who binds all things within eternal time... All that lies within this space...
(Before Raven can finish his incantation, the book rises out of his grasp.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s, catch it!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Huh? Telekinesis?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Got it, Letty!
(The adventurer leaps up and catches the approaching book. The Magic Bureau stops shaking.)
(Little by little, parts of the Magic Bureau begin to recover their original form, freed from the forbidden tome's power.)
(The space separating them from Raven shrinks again.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Damn it! Damn it! Why now...? I... I have to protect the remaining books... Break their seals...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Letty, grab him!

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: On it!
(Leticia tackles Raven's legs before he can escape, then uses a chain she has ready to bind his wrists.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Urgh!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Raven, what did you read in this book that made you do all this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tell me.
(Raven closes his eyes and clamps his mouth shut. Even bound, he refuses to let go of the three books.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I don't think we're getting an answer out of him, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...We'll hand him over to the knights.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Shall we head outside? Don't worry about our prisoner. I've tied him up nice and tight.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I've done my duty as a knight. Now I can finally take a break. Hehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What did Raven see in this book that drove him to do those things...?)
(The moment the adventurer looks at the book, everything before them freezes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what's happening?
(Darkness seeps in from nowhere and fills the world. A voice %s has never heard before whispers in their ear.)
『...Is it you?』
『Then I shall allow you to read a portion of Ars Paulina. These records of time may be of use to you.』
『But this time is not yours to keep. You will have only a moment.』

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ah!)
(The adventurer tries to cry out upon regaining their senses, but no sound emerges.)
(It is as though all of Etoile's time has vanished from this space. Glowing pages drift around the adventurer as if stirred by a breeze.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Can I move?)
(There is nothing they can do except reach toward the pages.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Whoever made this place seems to be preventing me from doing anything else. What should I do?)
(As the adventurer hesitates, glowing pages fall to the floor. Once swallowed by the darkness, they can no longer be seen.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...So that's what they meant about having little time. Only a few pages left. I'd better hurry.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Which of the three should I choose?)
(The adventurer touches the page glowing blue. Its light rises into the air and takes the shape of someone's image.)

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: You've gathered more mages since my last visit.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: The faith of intelligent people is simple, yet profound. They believe that their hunger for new truths and knowledge can change the world.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: I believe it. So do they. Our work is proceeding smoothly, in part thanks to you.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Aaron. How much of the witches' power have you collected?

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: You don't need to know.
(Raven smirks at Aaron's reply.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: At first, I was intrigued by your proposal. You seemed to understand the kind of man I am. But even after everything we've done together, you still keep so many secrets.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: When you recognized me, I recognized you too. I found it fascinating that no one realized the head of House Tienes was always the same being...

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Thanks to you, I killed Jerenis before he could interfere further, and gathered plenty of beastfolk to create a demon god. I am grateful for that.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: I've glimpsed the truth of this world. Did you think I wouldn't see what a demon like you was doing? You're waiting for a witch to be born into the imperial family.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: It all ends when that day comes, doesn't it? When you can finally achieve whatever it is you want...

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: I won't deny it.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: What bargain did you strike with the rabbit-eared witch? You asked her to keep making vessels for you.

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: Her child must not die. As long as that condition is fulfilled, her bargain with me will never end.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Then that rabbit witch must be holding the power of all the witches you've killed.
(The faint images in the darkness gradually fade from sight.)
(The adventurer touches the page glowing yellow. Its light rises into the air and takes the shape of someone's image.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: The experiments using fear are progressing smoothly, but I don't know when they'll be complete...

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: They will be needed when the time comes. Until then, I can wait.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: When that happens, I'd appreciate being left out of the Demon Realm's plans...

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: I'll consider it, Crowley. Now... is that child your latest vessel?

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: This vessel is quite promising. I spent a long time blending many souls together, then left it to dream in LaChouette's waterways.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: When it awoke, it roused an ancient magic golem from its slumber. A very promising vessel. The only drawback is that its emotions haven't stabilized yet.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: So I made use of a certain nobleman. You've heard the rumors about the Gentleman, haven't you...?

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: There was a problem when he dumped the dead into the waterways. The vessel escaped and hid in a storeroom at the Magic Bureau.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: I barely managed to recapture it. In the meantime, it had killed someone who tried to save it. The mages had tormented it for so long, it assumed he would do the same.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: It's a shame to lose a mage like Nemo, but it must have been a new experience for No Name. And this vessel is better than Atalante, who is slated for disposal.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: By the way, Lux. Was killing the emperor part of your plan too? And what about that demon, Barbatos?

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: I know Princess Shiina is the reincarnation of that woman, the empire's first sovereign. But apart from her exceptional magical power...

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: You're a curious human. Very well, I'll answer.

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: I don't know which of the three sisters is destined to become a witch, but...
(The adventurer touches the page glowing red. Its light rises into the air and takes the shape of someone's image.)
『Crowley!』

lines.speaker: 크롤리
lines.text: Master, no matter what you say, I will pursue my ambition.
『Humans must stay within the bounds of their humanity. What you propose would deny humanity itself!』

lines.speaker: 크롤리
lines.text: You always said that magic exists to serve humanity, Master. That was why you used it to help the people.

lines.speaker: 크롤리
lines.text: I followed your teachings, but I felt that wasn't enough.

lines.speaker: 크롤리
lines.text: People call you an archmage because you can wield magic that ordinary people cannot. It is a blessing.

lines.speaker: 크롤리
lines.text: In this world, those few who possess that blessing are expected to use it for those who cannot wield magic.

lines.speaker: 크롤리
lines.text: And that is why I intend to go further for their sake.

lines.speaker: 크롤리
lines.text: For Freios, abandoned by the gods, I will uncover the ancient truths that others have barely touched...
『Those things were forbidden and sealed away in those books for a reason!』

lines.speaker: 크롤리
lines.text: Were they?

lines.speaker: 크롤리
lines.text: Even so, a taboo can simply be broken. A forbidden book can simply be read.

lines.speaker: 크롤리
lines.text: Master.

lines.speaker: 크롤리
lines.text: Your magic is so antiquated that I can hardly bear to watch. I will carry on your will from here...
『You wretch, Crowley...』

lines.speaker: 크롤리
lines.text: Rest in peace.

lines.speaker: 크롤리
lines.text: Jerenis, the narrow-minded, foolish mage I once respected as my teacher...
(The glowing pages fall to the floor and disappear into the darkness.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Crowley...

steps.name: A Suspicious Gate
steps.objective: Talk to [Leticia] in 「Glaston Administrative District」, then turn in the quest to [Passing Bluebird] in 「Glaston Administrative District」.

lines.text: (Startled by a blinding light, the adventurer looks around and meets Leticia's worried gaze.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Are you all right, %s? Cough, cough...
(Leticia wipes blood from her lips, looking apologetic.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine, but what happened to you, Letty?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I should've held on to that mage more tightly...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? What do you mean...

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Don't you remember? We were taking Raven outside when you muttered 'Crowley,' %s!

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Raven suddenly looked startled, and then the spellbook exploded.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: It sent us flying out of the building! Don't you remember?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: You really don't remember, huh? Anyway, Raven escaped in the confusion, and the Spirit King went after him!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right, Letty?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: The Spirit King gave me a mysterious mushroom. I felt better after eating it. Would you like one too, %s?
(Just then, Peekaboo spots something from the sky and hoots at them.)

lines.speaker: 피카부
lines.text: Hoooot! Hoooooot!

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I think Peekaboo saw something over there. Peekaboo, is the Spirit King that way?

lines.speaker: 피카부
lines.text: Hoot!

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Let's follow Peekaboo's directions, %s. You're sure you're okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine, Letty. Nothing hurts. Oh, I can see something over there...

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: You mean the gate?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A gate?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: You know, one of those gates powered by magic. There are some at the Nereis Gateway too.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: The Magic Bureau's mages put it up ages ago, but nobody uses it now. It's just been left there.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Running that way won't do him any good...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Unless...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's hurry.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Oh, aren't you coming, Peekaboo?

lines.speaker: 피카부
lines.text: Hoooot!

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Okay, then. Stay away from the monsters and take your friends to the square, all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thanks, Peekaboo. See you later.

lines.speaker: 피카부
lines.text: Hoot!

steps.name: The Encroachment of Evil
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Passing Bluebird] in 「Glaston Administrative District」, then defeat [Laudskina] in 「Pseudaria」 and obtain the <Minister Badge>.
2. Turn in the quest to [Passing Bluebird] in 「Glaston Administrative District」.

lines.text: (Following Leticia deeper into the administrative district, the adventurer finds the huge, disused gate she described.)
(Sylphid sits atop the gate, gazing blankly at the sky.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirrr. What am I supposed to do about this?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: What's wrong, Spirit King?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Are you two all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We seem to be. Sylphid, there's something I need to tell you... Do you know anything about this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The adventurer tells Sylphid about Ars Paulina.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirrr. You... Chirp. It sounds like you've visited a realm even I know nothing about, and I'm a Spirit King. How should I put it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirrr. First, about Raven. Or rather, Crowley.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. The contents of those forbidden tomes, that primordial power he called the truth of the world... To use it, you must stake everything you are.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirrr. Otherwise, it won't lend its power to anyone, human or otherwise. You need power of your own to begin with, too... Anyway, it seems Crowley wagered himself to tamper with those tomes and break their seals.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. One of those powers took physical form, and you defeated it. And if another power recognized you and showed you Crowley's past...

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Crowley won't be able to use what he read in the forbidden tomes anymore. However...

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: You're saying that antisocial old guy went somewhere he could still use that power, right?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirrr. Exactly. You're quick on the uptake, kid.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Thanks, Spirit King.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If this gate leads somewhere Crowley can do that... Could it be the Demon Realm...

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. You're right. Beyond this gate lies the Demon Realm. I can only sense it faintly, so it must be very far away, but they're definitely connected.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirrr. I did hear that the journey to the Demon Realm is longer than you might think...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If he uses the forbidden tomes' power in the Demon Realm, things could get even worse. We have to open this gate...

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirrr. Only demons can open a gate to the Demon Realm.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirrr. The Demon Realm is another world beyond the Great Wall, one that exists in defiance of everything here. To reach it from our world requires the power of a god.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris...

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Yes. We would need the help of Lady Iris, who maintains the Great Wall.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Where is she, Spirit King? Just tell me where to go, and I'll hurry over there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right, Letty. I can talk to her.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Huh? How?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris... Can you do this?
(At %s's words, a glowing orb appears before the group.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirrr. Lady Iris, you've come?

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: Hello, Sylphid. And hello to you too, Leticia.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wh-where's that voice coming from? This shiny thing, right?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Calm down, kid. It's the goddess.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow, the goddess I've heard so much about?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, I need your help... if we're going to pursue Crowley.

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: It's all right. Catching Crowley comes first. I'll briefly reconstruct part of this area. That should make it possible, if only for a moment.

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: We don't have much time. Everyone, stand back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right, Iris. Letty, get behind me.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Okay.
(The orb moves before the empty gate and grows larger. A figure emerges from within it, seemingly clothed in all the world's purest, most beautiful light.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Iris?
(Iris stands before the gate in a form the adventurer has never seen before, a great bow in her hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That's Celestia...)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: O world of mine.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: My name is Iris, descendant of the Derr whom Lady Seres left behind.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: O world of mine. Our world, which holds sacred the names of all who have opened their eyes to life and closed them in death.
(Shafts of light descend from the sky and circle Celestia. They flow to Iris's fingertips and become a beautiful arrow of light.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I shall pierce this unholy darkness. Become the light at the tip of Celestia, the bow of the Derr that I now wield.
(The arrow grows sharper and sharper, then flies forth from Celestia.)
Whoooosh!
(With a piercing whistle, the arrow strikes the empty center of the gate.)
(An invisible wall splits apart. Fragments fall to the ground and dissolve into dust.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirrr. That place...
(Beyond the formerly sealed gate stretches a road steeped in menace. At its end, a castle gleams beneath a violet moon.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This feels like entering Rosengarten...)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The Demon Realm begins at the castle at the end of that road. I'm sorry, %s.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I wish I could pursue Raven with you, but if I set even one foot in the Demon Realm... beings from other worlds will come for this one.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: They will say that even one of its last remaining gods has abandoned Etoile... Go. Hurry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Lady Iris is right, %s. Leave things here to me.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I'm going too! We've got a bad guy to catch!

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirrr. Kid, that place would be dangerous even for a spirit like me. It's much worse for an ordinary human.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Stay here and help me keep other monsters from coming through.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I guess there's no helping it. Okay.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Oh, %s! Raven's running over there!
(Leticia points into the gate, having spotted Raven on the other side.)
(Raven, nowhere to be seen a moment ago, clutches the spellbooks and looks around anxiously.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be back, Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll catch Raven—Crowley—and make him answer for what he's done.
(Leaving the others behind, the adventurer runs through the gate and into the passage bordering the Demon Realm.)
(A vast road stretches endlessly over blue clouds, bathed in violet light. Ominous red liquid stains its surface.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...What is this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It looks like blood... but not quite. Huh? What's that...?
(A magic circle covers a round stretch of road large enough to hold dozens, perhaps hundreds of people. Blue flames surround it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is this place...?
(As %s looks around, Raven comes into view again, seemingly lost.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can catch up to him from here.
(At that moment, Raven's eyes meet %s's.)
(His earlier anxiety gone, Raven gives %s a sneering smile, then races toward the castle.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whatever you're planning at the end of this road... I won't let you have your way, Crowley.
(In a space so vast that %s can no longer tell how far or how deep they have run, they finally stop.)
(Raven stands at a dead end, facing the adventurer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You've stopped running. There's nowhere left to go, Raven.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Or should I say Crowley?
(Raven grins as the name Crowley leaves %s's lips.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: When did I last hear someone else call me that? I have lived as Raven for a very long time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you trying to say?

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: If you saw my past in Ars Paulina, you must know what kind of man I am.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I never wanted to know...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But if you insist on hearing it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You murdered the mage Jerenis and tried to use the forbidden tomes to create a demon god...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You incited the mages and used the people of Creed as materials for that god...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...So many people died. For what? Who gave you the right? Why did you do it?
(Raven listens in silence, then a smile spreads across his face.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: A special human blessed by a god, and you understand nothing. Just like that fool Jerenis, who had power and refused to use it.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: The gods fought amongst themselves until Beast devoured them or drove them away. The Demon King took their place. And what have the gods done all this time?

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: I pitied this world. I worked to create a new one.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Then Jerenis returned after witnessing the truth of the world. There was power there. He could have brought it back...

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: But he sealed it away and did nothing. Foolish man. I begged him to use it, but he kept ignoring me...

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Great deeds demand sacrifice.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: So I killed him, used his power to break the seal, and glimpsed the truth myself. His death wasn't my fault. He brought it upon himself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How can you even say that?

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: I heard a message telling me to create a god to rule a new world. I made that my calling.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: I founded research institutes connected to the Magic Bureau and worked tirelessly for years.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: For this pitiful world whose gods have vanished...

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: For the lives in this pitiful world...

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: I undertook this work and its sacrifices on everyone's behalf.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: And the only one who understood me was a demon. Heh.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're insane...

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Call me insane if you wish. This is my calling, and I merely follow it.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: I shall continue my work here, %s.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: It occurred to me that I needn't spend all those years creating another vessel. There's excellent material right here.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: You won't offer yourself willingly, of course. So I will show you the power of truth. Even incomplete, it will be enough to turn you into my material.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Though I don't much care for doing this in a place Lux provided...
(Raven flings his glasses to the ground and opens all the forbidden tomes in his arms. He begins muttering feverishly.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Goetia, essence of evil buried by the ancient god in the darkness of the beginning.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Theurgia, primal force of life with which the ancient god created the spirits.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Almadel, power of obedience through which the ancient god commands the angels.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Nova, star of the abyss that pours forth every wound and tear.

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: ...Lend me your power, that I may once again create a god for this pitiful world!
(Shadows pour from the open tomes amid grotesque sounds. They swell around Raven and the books, blocking the adventurer's approach.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh... I... I can't get close...
(A vortex forms amid the black shadows, driving the adventurer backward.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Hahahahaha! Yes, this is it! This is true power! Hahahahaha!

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Gah! AAAAAARGH!
(Raven suddenly screams in pain.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Wh-what?!
(Raven struggles against something attacking him, but it is difficult to see.)
(As the vortex thins, the adventurer glimpses a forbidden tome baring its fangs like a monstrous beast.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: G-GAAAAH! S-stop! Why... Why me...? Aaaagh!

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: AAAAARGH!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: N-no... That's impossible...
(The four tomes bite down on Raven's hands and feet, one after another, swallowing them. Shadows gather from the books and gradually form another tome.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: All you had to do was give me power! Why are you doing this?! AAAAAARGH!
(The new book stares at Raven, then opens its mouth wide and bites down, engulfing his head.)
(A moment later, fresh blood sprays from the shadows.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Aah... Aaaaaah... S-save me...
(Raven's desperate cries grow fainter. His arms and legs fall limp, then drop to the ground.)
(The shadows and vortex fade, leaving only a horrific sight behind.)
(Demonlike horns sprout from the book that swallowed Crowley's head. The red liquid staining the ground rises and rushes toward him.)
(Consumed by blood and darkness, the human becomes a grotesque monster, barely resembling what he once was.)

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: Gah!
(The monster who was both Raven and Crowley regains its senses and looks around. The ground beneath the adventurer begins to shake violently.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Urgh...

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: I feel more powerful than I ever did wielding mere magic. So this is the power of the forbidden tomes?

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: This is power that can change the world...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Enough of your nonsense, Crowley!

lines.speaker: 레이븐
lines.text: I am no longer Raven or Crowley! I am the one who will kill you and raise a god in my stead...
(The monster, its head engulfed by a forbidden tome, stares at the adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 라우드스키나
lines.text: Laudskina...

lines.speaker: 라우드스키나
lines.text: And this is the perfect place to spread the truth of the world. Pseudaria...
Whirrr.
(A vast ring brimming with magic forms around the monster that calls itself Laudskina.)

lines.speaker: 라우드스키나
lines.text: As long as I possess this power, you will never return home.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All that boasting over power that isn't even yours...

lines.speaker: 라우드스키나
lines.text: I shall silence that mouth forever. Die, adventurer of the goddess!

lines.speaker: 라우드스키나
lines.text: Gah...
(%s's attack grazes Laudskina.)
(The book that swallowed Crowley's head coughs up red liquid.)

lines.speaker: 라우드스키나
lines.text: Cough, cough...
(Barely holding on, Laudskina unleashes another barrage at %s, but a powerful counterattack renders it useless.)

lines.speaker: 라우드스키나
lines.text: Huff... Huff...

lines.speaker: 라우드스키나
lines.text: This can't be happening. I won't be able to resume my research. I have to...
(Laudskina attacks again, but this time its attack fails to reach %s at all.)

lines.speaker: 라우드스키나
lines.text: I... I am Crowley! My mastery of magic made me director of the Magic Bureau. Years of research allowed me to create a demon god. I am a great man!

lines.speaker: 라우드스키나
lines.text: For someone like me to fail to defeat a mere human like you... Th-that's impossible...

lines.speaker: 라우드스키나
lines.text: I must fulfill my calling. Only then...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And what happens after you fulfill it?

lines.speaker: 라우드스키나
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you think a demon god you created would do to you? Would the people of a world ruled by a false god be happy? There would be no place in that world for the lives that exist now.

lines.speaker: 라우드스키나
lines.text: I have glimpsed the truth! There will always be a place for me! Now submit and become the material for my vessel...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Even now, you still don't understand.
(The ring surrounding Laudskina shatters. The body of the man who was Crowley starts to liquefy and drip away.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The world you thought so little of deserves no pity. It fell and got back up. It kept enduring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The world isn't the pitiful one...
(As %s attacks Laudskina again, something large drops to the ground.)
Thud.
(The book has opened its mouth and released Crowley's head. Crowley falls free and tumbles across the ground.)
Grrrrrr...
(The adventurer looks up at the grotesque sound. The forbidden tome lunges, baring its sharp teeth.)
(It lasts only a moment. Before it can swallow anything, %s tears the tome to pieces. Its remains fall onto Crowley's head.)
『No! The truth is in there! How could you d-do this...? I... I can't let death come any closer...』
(Crowley reaches out desperately, but can do nothing. The adventurer looks down at him with contempt.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Crowley.
『A special being who can wield magic... So, for this pitiful world...』
(Before Crowley can finish, %s tightens their grip on their weapon.)
『I should never have trusted a demon like Lux... Gah!』
(The man who spent so long lost in his delusions, untouched by guilt, vanishes as if evaporating. The strange moonlight at the Demon Realm's border illuminates the spot where he lay.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I've never felt so sick...)
(Only then does a passage leading elsewhere become visible. But an unseen wall blocks the adventurer, as if denying them entry.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's not what I came here for. For now, I have to go back...
(The road back remains thick with ominous traces of the Demon Realm.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What do I do next? Lux...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I have to stop Lux, but can I really do it? I still don't know how powerful he is...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (And Daphne...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll stop overthinking it. First, I'll go back and talk to Iris.
(The adventurer turns and runs back the way they came.)
...Truly impressive, %s.
(Once the adventurer has gone far enough that the moonlight no longer catches them, someone slowly emerges from the blocked passage toward the Demon Realm.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: At first, I wasn't even sure you'd survive. Now I find myself cheering you on.
(Daphne lowers her gaze to the torn remains of the forbidden tomes.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: How foolish, to put such faith in a demon. You never realized Lux was using you to see Lemegeton completed...
(Daphne looks up at the moon in the ominous sky and smiles.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: There was a reason the gods buried those things you called the truth.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Aaron...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: I imagine you're watching and listening from somewhere. In that case, let me tell you this.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Your plan has already fallen apart. Many people know who you are and what you want.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: That is why I believe this is the perfect moment.

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: The moment to make you pay for testing me.

steps.name: Revealing One's True Colors
steps.objective: Talk to [Passing Bluebird] in 「Glaston Administrative District」, then turn in the quest to [Leticia] in 「Street North of the Plaza」.

lines.text: (The instant the adventurer steps toward what seems to be the exit, the world rushes at them in a dizzying swirl of colors.)
Chirp.
(Feeling something settle on their head, the adventurer looks up to see a little blue bird fluttering its feathers.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Sylphid?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirrr. Are you all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine... Where's Iris?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Lady Iris couldn't stay away any longer. She has returned.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Are you okay, %s? What happened to that bad guy?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Yes, %s. What became of the mage?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The adventurer explains to Sylphid what happened beyond the gate.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow, what an awful person! Still so shameless, right to the very end...

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. You did well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know about that...

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirrr. I know how you must be feeling.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be all right after a while. Are all the monsters gone now?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: They suddenly disappeared, all at once!

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. The spirits affected by the miasma returned to where they belonged. The Magic Bureau's owl mages came outside and are busy throwing up.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirrr. The demons from the Demon Realm fled in a hurry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. What about the mages who turned into monsters inside the Magic Bureau?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Their hearts stopped the moment the forbidden tomes lost their power.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirrr. From what Peekaboo told me, they were trying to retrieve research documents and specimens when it happened.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Raven must have bargained away the lives of the mages who helped him in exchange for the tomes' power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...We have to catch Aaron quickly...

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirrr. %s. This is no time to rush into action. Don't dive at the first seed you see. There may be a trap.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. And you, kid.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yes, Spirit King?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirrr. Everything you saw and heard here is a secret. Understand?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Who would believe an ordinary human who claimed to have met a chirping Spirit King and a goddess?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirrr. Think of it as a secret mission.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wow, like a hero! Got it.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Soldiers are coming. What's wrong? There aren't any monsters or demons left...

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Soldiers? Are they from the council? As a heroic knight, I'll go ask what's going on.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Something feels wrong about those soldiers... Just like that other time...)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Excuse me...
(Before Leticia can speak, the skirmishers surround the group and raise their rifles.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Wh-what are you doing?!

lines.speaker: 유격병
lines.text: ...The wrath spilling from the Gate of Doom... shall burn everything...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sylphid!
(Just as a skirmisher is about to pull the trigger, a great whirlwind rises.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. They've been brainwashed by the Demon Realm's influence. Kid, take their weapons, quickly!

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yes, Spirit King!
(Leticia tries to fling the soldiers' rifles away with telekinesis, but drops them instead. The adventurer takes the opportunity to subdue the startled skirmishers.)
(The respite is brief. More brainwashed skirmishers appear and surround them again.)

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Huff... Huff... There are too many soldiers... And they're ridiculously strong...

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirrr. They're ordinary humans, so we can only knock them unconscious. That takes time. %s, the soldiers... Wait.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Someone's coming.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes...
(The skirmishers surrounding the group stop moving. Their ranks part like the sea, and two people approach %s and the others.)

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: Now, tell us exactly what you saw.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: I saw it clearly with my own eyes. That person dragged Raven, a mage of the Magic Bureau, in there.
(Feta, a mage of the Magic Bureau, points at the now-inactive gate.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Feta?

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: Colluding with demons and abducting Raven of the Magic Bureau. That should suffice.

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: Arrest this person.
(As though on cue, the soldiers advance toward %s at Aaron's command. But when they see the card in %s's hand, they recoil in surprise.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Are they reacting to this card?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was carrying out an imperial mission concerning Raven.

lines.speaker: 유격병 A
lines.text: Our apologies. Huh? Chairman Aaron, what brings you here...?

lines.speaker: 유격병 B
lines.text: Weren't we at the council hall a moment ago?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Has the brainwashing worn off...?)
(Aaron gives a small, knowing smile. Darkness surges in from nowhere and blankets the administrative district.)
(Every living thing touched by the darkness stops moving and collapses. Even Sylphid, watching from a tree, falls to the ground.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (How is he controlling space and time like this? W-wait...)
(Before the adventurer can understand what is happening, the darkness filling the air rushes toward Aaron.)

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: So you intend to interfere...

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: Very well. I shall entertain the will of a being rejected by the world. Daphne.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne?

lines.speaker: 아론
lines.text: I'll postpone dealing with you. You had better stay alive until then...
(At Aaron's words, the darkness around him surges skyward like a waterfall flowing in reverse.)
(It swells until it could cover all of Glaston, then crashes down as if heralding the end of the world.)

steps.name: Wishing You Luck
steps.objective: Talk to [Leticia] in 「Street North of the Plaza」, then head toward 「Glaston Central Plaza」. Once everything is over, press the Complete Quest button.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: %s! %s, wake up!
(A voice reaches the adventurer, and the darkness before them dissolves into nothing.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Are you all right?

lines.speaker: %s
