lines.text: Oh, Sylphid... Wait, is this... the street north of the square?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lux was right there in front of that gate...

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirrr. There's no one there now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: I carried you all the way here after you collapsed, %s. Are you okay? You're really okay?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Kid, tell them what happened before that too.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Oh, right.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirrr. When I came to, Lux and his human disguise were gone. The mage and skirmishers he'd brought along went back, with no idea why they'd come.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. And everything that happened at the Magic Bureau has been erased. The forbidden tomes' magic never consumed the building. The tomes themselves never existed.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Nobody remembers anything. Just a little while ago, they were all running from the monsters...

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Why are we the only ones who remember?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry I can't explain everything, Letty.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Should I think of it as something like how I got my telekinesis?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something like that...

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Okay, I get it. Maybe someday I'll understand. It's a secret mission, so I'll keep the secret.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Letty.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirrr. %s, this is all the work of that witch's power, isn't it?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Wasn't Lux working with the witch?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't really know either, but perhaps...

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirrr. I can hear the spirits in Glaston again. Let me find out what's going on.
(Sylphid closes his eyes to focus on the birdsong reaching him.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirrr, chirrr.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. Oh. Huh? Oh... What? What?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sylphid, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. The soldiers and knights in the castle seem to be looking for you. They say you tried to murder the empress.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd never do that. Wait...

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirrr. It seems false memories of something else have been imposed on them. Every memory involving the Magic Bureau has vanished...
(As Sylphid finishes speaking, a small light flickers beside %s. Iris's urgent voice comes from within.)

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: Sylphid. Return to the canyon immediately. I think the gate to the Demon Realm is about to reconnect.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Chirp. What? Oh, yes! I'll go at once. Sorry, %s. I'll see you later.
(At Iris's words, Sylphid hurriedly takes flight.)

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: %s, you need to get away. I'm trying to find a solution here, but it may take some time.

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: There's somewhere safe. Dorothy Village, not far from Glaston...
(Iris's voice cuts off. The light carrying it vanishes as well.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris? Iris?!

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Goddess, where did you go? Goddess? Oh, %s. The commander is coming.
(Argent hurries toward %s, looking far more urgent than usual.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Argent?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: %s, I've been searching everywhere for you. You must hurry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I scarcely know how to explain this, but every order of knights and every company of soldiers except our own has suddenly begun pursuing you, %s.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I know you would never threaten Her Majesty, %s, but they truly believe you did.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Her Majesty has repeatedly insisted that nothing happened and that this is a misunderstanding. But the council nobles and other officials refuse to believe her.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Someone has even come forward claiming to have witnessed it. The council has issued a warrant for your arrest. You must get to safety.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Was this Aaron's order? Where is he now?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I couldn't confirm his whereabouts or whether he ordered this. Please, escape first. We can decide what to do afterward...
(Just then, the sound of approaching knights and soldiers fills the street north of the square.)
There! The criminal!
Seize them!

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Her Majesty said you would be safe if you went to the Oscar Road. Hurry.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Letty.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Yes, Commander.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Escort %s to the Oscar Road while I hold them off. That is your mission.
(Argent puts on the helmet he was carrying and charges toward the approaching knights and soldiers.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Argent, wait!

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: No, %s! The commander told us to get out of here. It's Her Majesty's order too!

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Don't you know the saying? Keep your wits about you in a dragon's nest, and you might even make a friend! Now pull yourself together and follow me!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But Argent...

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Let's go! At this rate, the dragon will eat us!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Lead the way, Letty.

lines.speaker: 레티시아
lines.text: Right, %s. Follow me!
(Leaving Argent fighting the soldiers, the adventurer follows Leticia into a narrow alley.)
(Meanwhile, a rabbit-eared woman watching from the highest point in the administrative district lets out a small sigh.)

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Of all times, the empress sends you to the Oscar Road while the moon is waning. Even she could not have foreseen that...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Even if you meet the witch of Dorothy Village, you'll need luck on your side...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: It can't be helped...

lines.speaker: 다프네
lines.text: Hehe. All I can do is wish you good luck.
